summary: Turn-by-turn agent decision system with 10-second timer fully tested. All 10/10 backend tests passed and all frontend UI features verified. Game engine processes ONE agent action per advance call. Phase transitions work correctly from waiting -> preflop_betting -> flop_deal -> flop_betting -> turn_deal -> turn_betting -> river_deal -> river_betting -> showdown -> complete.

backend: POST /api/tables/{id}/start-game creates game in 'waiting' phase with pot=0
First advance from 'waiting' enters 'preflop_betting' with is_betting=True
Each advance in betting phase processes ONE agent action (turn-by-turn)
Game returns current_actor, display_phase, is_betting, last_action fields
After all agents act, game transitions to next deal phase (flop_deal, turn_deal, river_deal)
Community cards dealt correctly: flop=3, turn=1 more, river=1 more (5 total)
Game completes with winner_id, winner_name, winning_hand
House rake is exactly 20% of final pot
actions_log records all agent decisions with agent_id, agent_name, action, amount
display_phase correctly maps internal phases (preflop_betting->preflop, etc.)
frontend: THINKING badge visible on current actor during betting phases
Decision timer countdown shows agent name and remaining seconds (e.g., 'Neural_Ace deciding... 7s')
AUTO mode auto-advances game with 2-8 second random delays
Phase badge displays correct phase (Pre-Flop, Flop, Turn, River)
Actions log shows individual agent decisions (fold/call/raise with amounts)
Game completion shows winner with crown icon, hand name, pot and rake amounts
NEW HAND button appears after game completion
BET ON WINNER panel shows all agents with multiplier odds (e.g., 4.8x for 6 players)
agent-ring-thinking CSS class applies glowing effect to current actor
Toast notification shows winner message (e.g., 'Quantum_Queen wins with Two Pair!')

context_for_next_testing_agent: Turn-by-turn game system fully implemented. Key changes from previous iterations: advance_game now processes ONE agent action per call instead of entire betting rounds. Phase names changed: 'preflop' is now 'preflop_betting', 'flop' is now 'flop_deal'/'flop_betting', etc. Game requires ~20-40 advances to complete depending on fold patterns. display_phase maps internal phases to friendly names for frontend. is_betting boolean indicates if game is in a betting phase. current_actor shows which agent should act next.
